missed_steps.title: It answers
missed_steps.text: Calls you can't take go to your AI assistant's number. It answers with your name or your team's name. If a caller hangs up, it texts them within a minute, so sign calls don't go cold.

missed_steps.title: It qualifies
missed_steps.text: Buying or selling, which property or area, timeline, pre-approval, already working with an agent. Your questions, your order.

missed_steps.title: It books, you get a text
missed_steps.text: Showings, listing consults or buyer calls, only in the windows you open. You get the lead by text and email. Each lead can also be added to Follow Up Boss automatically (through Zapier, an app that connects apps).

faq.q: Does it work with Follow Up Boss?
faq.a: Yes. A Zapier link is included (Zapier is an app that connects apps): each new lead and booking can add a contact and a to-do in Follow Up Boss. Booking into Google Calendar or Calendly is included too.

faq.q: Can it answer questions about my listings?
faq.a: It answers from the facts you give it (address, status, open house times, your FAQ). It won't guess about price changes, offers or property condition. It hands those to you.
